gate_reasoning: Stage 3 scores 52% High / 24% Medium / 24% Low across 42 claims. The High-tier claims cover the most analytically load-bearing assertions: ASEAN penetration benchmarks (OJK Roadmap primary confirmed in cache), insured lives growth divergence (Milliman authored PDF confirmed in cache), CDM claims cost drivers (PMC peer-reviewed confirmed in cache), Swiss Re health protection gap (authored PDF confirmed in cache), and POJK regulatory reform timeline (Milliman e-Alert + Lockton independently confirmed). The 10 Low-tier claims fall into three groups: (a) 4 auto-Low-vendor product document claims that are NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH (Prudential, Allianz plan benefits) — these are structural gaps in plan composition evidence; (b) 3 ASSUMED-N estimates without primary sources (pharmacy OOP Rp range, underwriting loading rates, self-employed population count); (c) 3 single-source secondary claims (H1 2024 general insurance sub-segment, H1 2025 individual loss ratio, BPJS contribution via advisory site). The stage can ship with flags noting: (1) the top-5 weak claims require deep research before plan-composition claims are treated as evidenced; (2) the premium time series OJK primary must be attended-fetched to upgrade VC3.2.1 from Medium to High; (3) vendor product documents (Prudential, Allianz) must be obtained via OJK IKNB product registry or Playwright to evidence the plan-composition exclusion claims that are central to Pain points 3.1 and 3.3.
